title: AI Assistant
hook: I hit rate limits and it cost me a day
subtitle: Lessons from building a personal multi-agent AI assistant

slides.heading: Latency Issues
slides.body: Median response time: 6.7 seconds, p90: 24.0 seconds

slides.heading: Rate Limit Fix
slides.body: Capped tool results, compacted history, limited concurrent agents

slides.heading: Rate Limit Types
slides.body: Per-minute and per-day limits require different handling

slides.heading: Model Fallback
slides.body: Chain of models from different providers for reliability

slides.heading: Model Choice
slides.body: Some models can't handle structured tool calling

slides.heading: Automation Pitfalls
slides.body: Incomplete automation and formatting issues can cause failures

caption:
Building a personal multi-agent AI assistant was harder than I thought. 
Here are the key lessons I learned. 
From rate limits to model fallback, I'm sharing my first-hand experience.
